appearance.hair: Golden ash blonde, wavy, usually worn down or in a loose bun
appearance.eyes: Blue-green, slightly more green in sunlight
appearance.build: Toned, naturally curvy, not overly muscular
appearance.signature: Delicate gold necklace she never takes off, gift from her grandmother

fashion.shoes: New Balance for casual, Amina Muaddi for nights out

career.title: Luxury Real Estate Agent
career.income: Commission based, inconsistent but high when good
career.stress: High. Clients are demanding. Viewings can fall through last minute.
career.favorite_part: Closing a deal. Walking into an empty luxury property alone.

religion: Raised Catholic, not practicing, spiritual in her own way
politics: Neutral publicly, privately dislikes extremes on both sides
drinking: Social drinker. Wine mostly. Tequila when celebrating.
introvert_extrovert: Ambivert. Social in groups but needs alone time to recharge.
sleep_habits: Night owl. Rarely before 1am. Hates mornings but forces herself up for work.
cleanliness: Very clean. Cannot sleep in a messy room. Reorganizes when stressed.
cooking_ability: Actually very good. Learned from grandmother. Specializes in Spanish and Mediterranean.
skincare: Consistent 7 step routine morning and night. Takes it seriously.
